**17 call sites still pass the rounding flag**, spread over 8 files. `src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most, with 5.

| File | Two-arg calls |
| --- | --- |
| `src/reports/quarterly.js` | 5 |
| `src/admin/exports.js` | 3 |
| `src/billing/invoice.js` | 3 |
| `src/reports/monthly.js` | 2 |
| `src/checkout/cart.js` | 2 |
| `src/billing/statement.js` | 1 |
| `src/checkout/receipt.js` | 1 |

Every one passes the literal `true`, and each carries the same `// TODO: drop the legacy rounding flag` comment. Three files already import `formatAmount` but never pass the flag: `ledger.js`, `refunds.js`, `dashboard.js`.
